editorial.blurb: Chef Gabriela Dávila's intimate Mexican restaurant delivers elevated antojería where every dish tells a story and lands as flawlessly as the chef's TV-famous cooking.
editorial.insiderTip: Book well in advance and arrive early enough to linger—the chef often greets tables personally, and the small, energetic space (with Latin music and lively chatter) rewards those who settle in rather than rush.
